_fixture: ORACLE (independent, gemmi only, no mw import): M24 T1 expected neighbors / windows / ligand distances for public 1UBQ and 1MQ4. Not product output.

assumptions.W1: the window includes the target residue (5 before + target + 5 after, cut at chain ends)
assumptions.W2: one-letter codes by the M20 one_letter rule: the 20 standard names plus the ten mapped names (HID/HIE/HIP/HSD/HSE/HSP H, CYX C, ASH D, GLH E, LYN K); any other name (incl. MSE) is X
assumptions.N1: protein residue = gemmi het_flag 'A' (ATOM record), as M20 positions; first model only
assumptions.N2: a protein residue without heavy atoms is never a neighbor (no distance)
assumptions.N3: a target residue without heavy atoms has neighbors null (not computed), never []
assumptions.D1: distances are math.dist on gemmi float64 positions; <= 5.0 inclusive
